report.summary:
Countercheck complete on the supplied packet: I found no ACTUALLY reachable mixed-pool defect in recordRiskReview. The guard arithmetic in the previous P3 was indeed wrong: with withheld absent, execution reaches the `else if(riskIndex>=report.risks.length)` branch, so index 0 against a published pool of length 0 evaluates 0>=0 as true and throws the 'Choose a published risk in this report.' DomainError at line 21, before lines 22–30 run. No annotation is created and the quote is not mutated. The suppressed withheld pool can therefore never be reached through a default (absent-origin) lookup. Trace for that absent-origin path: line 12 sets withheld=false, line 13 is skipped, lines 15–17 confirm the delivery/report binding and numeric index, line 18's if(withheld) branch is not entered, line 21 rejects index 0 against an empty risks array, and lines 22–30 are unreachable. Explicit origin works as intended: line 12 sets withheld=true, and line 19 reads `report.withheldRisks.entries[riskIndex]`, with line 20 requiring pool.version===1, reason==='item_status_adjusted', an Array entries with length ≤5, and entry.originalRiskIndex===riskIndex plus a truthy entry.risk. Last, line 26's 'latest matching entry' lookup (findLast) keys on riskOrigin===(withheld?'withheld':undefined) and riskIndex, so an absent-origin review can never be deduplicated against, or treated as a retry of, a withheld-origin review at the same numeric index. The two pools stay separate: the absence-vs-'withheld' key distinguishes them at both lookup (line 19) and idempotence (line 26). Nothing in this file constructs a mixed pool. The supplied tests are consistent with that reading: fixture() builds a withheld-only pool (published=false), and fixture(true) builds a published pool with reason 'not_withheld' and empty entries, never both pools populated.

The evidence supporting the above comes from the supplied source only. I did not execute anything, run the suite, or replay stage 18. I did not inspect assessment generation, the export verifier, or code that creates other publication pools outside the packet. The user's statement that valid generated pools never mix and that export rejects hand-built mixed pools, plus the claimed test counts and stage-18 replay result, is reported as their assertion, not as something this review verified. Consequently, this review cannot by itself prove that no production generator path mixes the pools; that conclusion rests on the user's assertion plus the export's assumed rejection. This review addresses the absent/withheld origin lookup only, not a broad new audit.
limitations: Advisory, source-only review of the three supplied files (lib/risk-reviews.ts, tests/risk-review-origins.test.ts, .agents/skills/proofbeforepay-delivery/SKILL.md). No code was executed, no test suite was run, and no stage-18 replay or origin-test run was performed or verified.

The claim that valid generated publication pools never mix withheld and published pools cannot be proven from this packet. The pool-construction and export-validation code is not included, so that claim is taken as the user's assertion, conditional on that external code.

The packet shows only one fixture shape per state (withheld-only or published-empty). It does not prove the absence of a generator that populates both risks and withheldRisks.entries in a validly exported assessment.

This review covers the absent/withheld origin lookup, pool selection at lines 18–21, and the idempotence key at line 26 only. It does not audit assessment-display indexing, evidence-export verification, acceptance-basis logic, source-visibility behavior, or the 100-record limit.

Tests and other modules imported by the test file (acceptance-client, proof-workflow, risk-repairs, source-visibility, evidence-export, assessment-display) are not supplied, so their behavior is unverified.
No runtime environment, storage, API, or UI behavior was inspected, consistent with the source-only constraints.
